name: code-terraform-docs-mcp
description: MCP server for Code: Terraform docs, script analysis, game control, and debugging

scripts.clean: node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true });"
scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/copy-assets.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.fixtures.json && node --import tsx --test test/*.test.ts
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test
scripts.precommit: lint-staged && npm run check && npm run lint
